1642746.title: The Daoxian Incident
1642746.overview: The result of years of fieldwork and research, "The Daoxian Incident" examines the causes of armed struggle and mass killings in Dao County, Hunan, at the height of the Cultural Revolution. Between August 13 and October 17, 1967, 7,696 people were killed and 1,397 were forced to commit suicide. An additional 2,146 were permanently injured or disabled. Most of the victims were labeled “class enemies” and belonged to the so-called “Five Black Categories,” while at least 14,000 people participated in the killings. Through interviews with survivors, participants, and family members, this documentary reconstructs the complex sequence of political campaigns that culminated in one of the bloodiest episodes in the PRC's history.

1643130.title: Remember the Summit

During the filming, Chris once again set foot on the territory of Estancia Cerro Guido, closing a circle between past and present, between the epic of mountainneering and the fragility of memory.

1718714.title: Eden Avenue
1718714.overview: A naive artist, weighed down by perfectionism, trades his innocence for a life of independence after falling for his muse.  Centered around themes of forming one’s identity, independence, and principles, this coming-of-age drama alludes to messages that grow increasingly relevant to a complex contemporary society.

1720570.title: PLUGGED-IN
1720570.overview: In a dystopian society where people are fully emotionally dependent on music, Paul, having broken his listening devices, tries to find his own sound.

1720698.title: Leave the Lights On
1720698.overview: Elinor, a young woman brimming with life and imagination, arrives at Adam’s apartment in Jerusalem, where he lives surrounded by piles of boxes that have sat sealed since his parents died. They plan to travel to his childhood home in Ukraine – a journey Elinor sees as the start of a shared life – but over the night before the flight it becomes clear that Adam cannot leave: not the apartment, not the objects, and not his past. Every object ignites a memory in him, and Elinor is drawn into the stories, spinning them into fantasies of a future together. Yet as the night wears on, the enchanted veneer cracks and the relationship is exposed as toxic and deceptive. By the end of the film, Elinor must choose whether to stay in the relationship as it is, or step out into an unknown world.

1724794.title: First Zone
1724794.overview: In a future flooded Netherlands, a hardened woman living in a wind turbine is torn from her desolate home by a violent storm. As she fights her way back, she begins to question whether the place she once called home still holds any meaning at all.

1724922.title: Quickstepper
1724922.overview: Over one weekend, a young boy and his new pet fox tag along as his father chases a drug deal meant to fix all his problems.

1725370.title: Satluj
1725370.overview: Triggered by the search for his missing aunt, Punjab human rights activist Jaswant Singh launches a dangerous investigation in his attempts at uncovering the conspiracy behind thousands of disappearances and extrajudicial killings.

1727418.title: Obsession Unleashed
1727418.overview: An inside look at the making of Obsession, and its creative process.

1727482.title: Last Chance to Evacuate Earth
1727482.overview: A casual kidnapping takes Crystal to rural Victoria with her estranged best friend. Though Chester promises a pleasant getaway, the mystery of his unexplained two-year absence - and a looming cosmic event threaten to overshadow their journey.
1727482.trailerName: Last Chance to Evacuate Earth | Trailer

1727994.title: Genuïns, això és una altra lliga

1728954.title: My Grandfather Charles Manson
1728954.overview: Sophia was always the good girl growing up and her father's rock, but her quest to identify her unknown grandfather results in a shocking discovery: He is Charles Manson, history's most notorious criminal; and he bears striking physical similarities to her beloved father. Sophia's discovery propels her into an underworld of Manson family members and unreliable narrators as she traces her grandfather's life. Along the way, her genetics unlock never-before-released records and audio recordings that illuminate Manson's pathology in startling ways. But the more Sophia uncovers, the more her relationship with her father is strained. For Sophia, there's no turning back. What has she inherited, and how will she reckon with her family legacy?

1731194.title: Cassiopeia
1731194.overview: When a star falls from the sky and lands in a young girls back yard, she rushes out to help send the star back home

1731258.title: COULDN'T AFFORD A JOINT SO I PRETEND
1731258.overview: I couldn't afford to buy marijuana. Then I pretend to smoke any.

1732730.title: What is love?
1732730.overview: What is love? is a cinematic short film written, directed, edited and filmed by student filmmaker Will Greive. The story follows a young couple through the speech of a touching poem. As the film progresses we see that a simple question can transition into a meaningful realization. Capturing the beauty of teenage desire, the film doesn't just show love; it allows the audience to experience it.

1733562.title: El murmullo del agua
1733562.overview: During a birthday party, Luca, a sensitive and lonely boy, begins to feel out of place among the other children. As tensions rise, he takes refuge in the fantasy of being a mermaid, imagining a place where he can breathe.

1735482.title: Sebastian Wasserberg's Big Day
1735482.overview: A ginger boy called Sebastian Wasserberg navigated secondary school while dealing with ladies, friends, hard drugs, and crime. One faithful day, he somehow accidently time travels and accidently kills Hitler, leading to insane consequences.

1737274.title: One of the Girls
1737274.overview: A short documentary following Mary, a Japanese American immigrant, single mother, and electrologist whose gender-affirming care has made her a trusted figure in the lives of transgender women.

1737530.title: After Ego
1737530.overview: A short film by Mari Mantela.

1739450.title: The Twin Who Lived
1739450.overview: After discovering she once had a twin sister who died when she was a child, Claire begins receiving strange gifts signed with her sister's name. What at first seems like a cruel prank soon escalates into disturbing signs that someone is breaking into her home and trying to take control of Claire's life.

1740090.title: Lazarus
1740090.overview: A young girl forced to watch her father’s murder before being killed herself, is brought back to life as the vengeance-seeking monster, Lazarus.

1740410.title: Inferno
1740410.overview: Footage of the January 2025 Southern California wildfires is accompanied by narration from biblical passages about Hell from the Greek translation of the Bible, bringing together the antiquity, modernity, reality and fantasy.

1741498.title: LOOP
1741498.overview: In a near-future world where technology has rendered most human labor obsolete, Zoe Pearce, a despairing artist, finds herself selected as a finalist for the universe challenge. This exclusive competition promises membership in humanity's most coveted experience: complete digital personalized immersion, where pain, suffering, and unwanted emotions are eliminated.

1741690.title: Fanny
1741690.overview: The ambitious hairdresser Fanny must survive within the demanding world of the Viennese court. When she pays no mind to the existing rules and moralities of the time, she draws the unexpected attention of the Empress, as well as a public audience.

1742458.title: Confinement
1742458.overview: Pregnant and recently widowed, Stella is taken in by her late husband’s estranged family. But beneath their generosity lies something deeply unsettling, leaving Stella fighting for her life as their obsession with her unborn child turns deadly.

1743098.title: Evel
1743098.overview: A young woman is held hostage in an EV self-driving car on an isolated northern highway. The car is controlled by a malevolent force that wipes out her digital footprint and her very existence, then delivers her to a Billionaire predator.﻿

1743994.title: Sunburn
1743994.overview: When a citywide blackout knocks out the power on one of the hottest days on record, a group of neighborhood kids set out in search of relief, unaware that the day will quietly mark the end of their childhood.

1744186.title: Zrywka
1744186.overview: A harsh, unforgiving environment—forests covering mountain slopes and the crash of falling trees punctuated by the heavy breathing of horses. In these conditions, the bond between human and animal is put to the test. Where does the line lie between exploitation and humane treatment? How do we define our place in the natural world? This film certainly offers no clear answers.

1744826.title: Eye to Eye
1744826.overview: A young man helps his girlfriend to see without sight.

1745146.title: Tunnel Vision
1745146.overview: Tunnel Vision follows the hardcore graffiti bomber "Rolex", dedicated to a lost and rare discipline in the Stockholm graffiti scene – Painting hard-to-access innercity subway stations, knowing that as soon as he sets his foot next to the station platform, police and transit security will be on their way.

1745210.title: Bodega Cat
1745210.overview: An animated film about a bodega cat who protects the store from robbers at night.

1746554.title: LILITH
1746554.overview: SHE LEFT ONE MORNING AND NEVER ARRIVED—NOW SOMETHING’S HOME, AND IT ISN’T ALIVE.

1747130.title: How the Sausage Was Made
1747130.overview: A making-of doc for “Fuck My Son.”

1748538.title: Okay? Alright.
1748538.overview: A reclusive Filipino-Korean man travels back in time to kill his pregnant mother in hopes of ceasing to exist. But in doing so, he obtains a certain hope that his life will turn out okay.

1749626.title: Porkatal
1749626.overview: On his sixth birthday, Engin is separated from his mother, with whom he has lived in prison since his birth. Taken in by his grandparents, the boy struggles to adapt to the harsh realities of life in their village while working out a plan to reunite with his mother.

1750650.title: Karki Saila

1751226.title: Small Talk
1751226.overview: Elisabeth spends Christmas with her boyfriend Espen and meets his family for the first time. An unfortunate incident involving his grandmother turns an already uncomfortable family gathering into a nightmare, forcing Elisabeth and Espen to confront unfamiliar sides of each other.

1753786.title: IPPON
1753786.overview: For Alejandro, judo is more than just a sport: it’s a chance to represent Costa Rica at the Olympic Games. As he trains to face his rivals on the mat, he must also deal with a lack of financial support and personal struggles that threaten to derail his journey. Amid sacrifices, uncertainty, and perseverance, his struggle goes beyond the sport.

1754362.title: Chasing Studios' The Final Film

1756538.title: Harmonica
1756538.overview: On the eve of her 13th birthday, dreamy Letícia begins to see the world differently, as new paths lead her towards transformation.

1757050.title: Spicy
1757050.overview: When Miriam and her friends decide to play Spice Girls, she’s quickly assigned the role of Scary Spice because she’s black. But Miriam wants to be Posh Spice. This sets her and her friends off on a transformation project that alters her appearance drastically.

1758522.title: Black Lizard / Diamond Impulse
1758522.overview: Black Lizard Great detective Kogoro Akechi and the enigmatic female thief Black Lizard. Within their thrilling game of pursuit and evasion, a solitary, unspoken love gradually blossoms between hunter and hunted. Diamond Impulse A shimmering diamond, bursting with the power to awaken countless emotions and impulses in us. This is a sparking stage performance that mixes IMPULSE—ephemeral feelings: the passion and love of those who keep on singing and dancing; desire and envy—with the transparent serenity and seductive scintillation of a diamond.

1763770.title: Cuppa' Joe
1763770.overview: Beneath the canned laughter of a 1950s sitcom, an Asian-Native Hawaiian couple navigates a dystopian allegory of diaspora, identity, and the cost of belonging in America.

1764602.title: Palestine is here... where it has always been
1764602.original_title: La Palestine est là... où elle a toujours été

1766522.title: Simon
1766522.overview: Ulysse and Aurore are brother and sister and lives together during their college years. Rather cheerful and outgoing, Aurore tries to help her withdrawn little brother come out of his shell; he has been putting up barriers for himself since their older brother's death, a few years ago. So she takes him on a little tandem bike ride to help him let go and reconnect with her.

1767098.title: Mission Berndt II
1767098.overview: 4 years after the Events of "Mission Bernd", Tech-Millionaire Berndt Vollmer is met with treason inside his own ranks - the ruthless Dettinger could destroy his career forever. His only option remains a mysterious USB-Stick claiming his innocence, so Vollmer sets up a team of young lads to save him, unaware of the consequences, these actions will have...

1769786.title: The Passenger 2
1769786.overview: An uber driver picks up his client when his intrusive thoughts cause him to want to do awful things.

1770234.original_title: BTS World Tour 'Arirang' In São Paulo: Live Viewing

1771194.title: Hook: Never, Never Ending
1771194.overview: Straight from the set of HOOK, this hour-long documentary features never before seen behind the scenes footage.  Relive the adventure of creating this beloved film that has become a cult classic with extraordinary access to access to Steven Spielberg, Robin Williams, Dustin Hoffman, Julia Roberts, and the crew through interviews and footage captured during production, as well as Steven Spielberg’s home movies.  Experience the triumph and trials of making HOOK in a thrilling and nostalgic time capsule that audiences will treasure.
1771194.trailerName: Go Behind the Scenes of HOOK

1771578.title: Attention Seeker
1771578.overview: The Powers, a picturesque family. David Powers, a classic country singer with a comeback album on the horizon works away with his tools on the grounds of the estate. Janet Powers, the matriarch of the house toiling away in the kitchen preparing a feast for the family. Ben Powers, buried amongst the various computer windows of gameplay, text chats, and live streaming feeds. And Grace, dejected with a black eye starring into old pictures of days when she thought she was happy. One click is all it would take, it wouldn't undo any of what she's been through, and yeah it would probably make it all worse, she'd be attacked by everyone, the whole family would. A single click on the 'publish' button, and everything would come out, everything about her father, what it's like to live in this house. 'Why not' she thinks, 'I won't be here to see it, burn it all down'.

1773306.title: There Is a Me
1773306.overview: At six years old, Amy was torn from everything familiar and thrust into a system marked by instability, abuse, and neglect. Her childhood unfolded through foster care, sexual trauma, and addiction, leaving her wounded and angry long before she reached adulthood. At seventeen, her life fractured again when her mother was murdered. Grief-stricken and untethered, Amy fled to the streets of Nashville, where survival quickly gave way to exploitation and crack addiction. Over the next three years, she endured violence, repeated arrests, and profound isolation. In the darkest moments of her life, on the very streets that nearly destroyed her, Amy encountered God.

1774202.title: Handymen
1774202.overview: 2 Ex Marines accidentally trigger a war with the Cartel in this comedic tale of car trunks and cauliflower pizza.

1775674.original_title: Bus och mysterier med Alfons Åberg

1776954.title: Mitrata
1776954.overview: Mitrata follows three inseparable friends whose bond is hilariously and heart-warmingly tested by a chaotic twist of fate. Packed with laughter, loyalty, and life-changing choices, it is the ultimate celebration of the people who know us best.
1776954.trailerName: Mitrata Official Trailer | Viraj Ghelani, Deep Vaidya, Vishal Parekh, Vishwaa Joshi | Sept 25th
